Who We Are

A diversified portfolio, one vision

The company manages a diversified portfolio of investment, commercial, tourism, contracting and service activities, focused on integrated solutions, operational excellence and sustainable growth. Rawafed Al-Nile is an Egyptian company specializing in investment and development opportunities while contributing to economic growth.

Tourism & Travel Services

Religious, domestic and international tourism; tour and travel arrangement; hotel and motel management and operations.

Petroleum Services

Provision of petroleum support services.

Business Consulting

Accounting and bookkeeping, certified public accounting (CPA), legal advisory and consultancy.

Electromechanical Works

Maintenance and operation of electrical power stations, transmission lines and transformers.

Public Supplies

General procurement and supply for a wide range of industries and operational needs.

Contracting & Construction

General contracting, building and facility maintenance, trading of construction and building materials.

Our Strategic Identity

From diversification to integration

A structured growth strategy with the long-term ambition of evolving into a holding group of specialized, independent companies.

Vision

To build a diversified investment and development company that evolves into a group of specialized entities, creating sustainable value.

Mission

To develop and manage diverse investment and service activities, transforming opportunities into sustainable projects and business entities.

Strategic Direction

Diversify investments, integrate sectors, build partnerships, improve operating efficiency, and establish independent companies for each sector.

Integrity & transparencyProfessionalismCommitment & responsibilityQuality & efficiencyPartnership & sustainability
Investment philosophy: success is not measured by the number of activities, but by our ability to build specialized entities, manage them efficiently, and connect them through one investment vision. Target model: Rawafed Al-Nile (parent) → specialized companies → holding group.

Business model: a partnership-led ecosystem

Rawafed acts as an investment and development orchestrator, not the direct operator of every activity.

Strategic roadmap

Phase 1 · Foundation & Governance. Solid institutional structure, management and operational systems, investment priorities, governance framework.

Phase 2 · Subsidiaries & Project Launch. Establish and activate specialized entities and turn opportunities into revenue-generating operations.

Phase 3 · Strategic Alliances. Expand local and international partners and build operational and investment alliances.

Phase 4 · Regional Expansion. Target markets, strengthening presence in Egypt, the GCC and regional markets.

Tourism & Hospitality Investment

Hotels, resorts and travel services

An integrated investment vision for hotel and tourism projects, strengthening their management and operations through strategic partnerships that support asset value and sustainable returns.

Hotel investmentHotel managementResorts & villagesHospitalityTourism services

Swisstouch Oriental Resort, Marsa Alam

Located within the Oriental Coast destination on the Red Sea, along the Quseir–Marsa Alam Road. The founder, Nehad Samir, became involved through a personal partnership, forming part of his direct experience in hospitality investment.

Work is underway to transfer the relevant contractual interests and rights from the founder's personal capacity to the company, subject to completion of applicable legal and commercial procedures. Path: founder experience → contractual transition → Rawafed platform, supporting future hotel investment, resort development, hospitality management and tourism-asset operations.

BO SAMRA · Tourism & Aviation

A new tourism investment entity, currently under formation, born of an alliance between Rawafed Al-Nile (founding partner), Q Company (part of Abu Samra Group for Tourism) and an international investment partner from the UAE.

Saudi strategic partnerships

The platform is presented through a strategic agency partnership with Overseas W (owner Sultan Bandar Al-Otaibi), an exclusive agency for Hajj and Umrah service coordination in Saudi Arabia, and a cooperation protocol with Mawaraa Al-Bihar, founded and owned by Sultan bin Bandar Al-Otaibi, with Rawafed Al-Nile as Egyptian partner.

Service model: Hajj & Umrah coordination, travel & visa coordination, accommodation & hospitality, and market representation in Egypt within the exclusivity and territory defined by the protocol.

Abeer Aldyafa Company for Catering Services

Strategic alliance with Ma’a Wara’a Al-Bihar (Overseas-KSA), Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

About Us

A Saudi company with experience since 1440 AH (2019 AD), providing catering and food supply services for the workforce in companies, factories, and labor housing, whether for small or large numbers. It also provides meals for pilgrims and Umrah performers, as well as Iftar meals for fasting individuals, operating during peak seasons and throughout the year, and is committed to delivering the highest-quality service at all times.

Strategic Alliance Integration

Partnering with Ma’a Wara’a Al-Bihar Company (Overseas-KSA) for business coordination, accelerating growth, joint contracting, and operating catering sites across Makkah Al-Mukarramah and the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia within Rawafed Al-Nile’s regional partnership network.
